# Infolocs of an Object of Class ltraj

Modified version of
[`infolocs`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/adehabitatLT/man/burst.html) that: 1)
allows to return a single data frame by burst or id (parameter `"by"`);
2) can simply the output to a vector if a single column is requested
(parameter `"simplify"`); 3) returns `NULL` if `infolocs` exists, but
`which` is not a colum of it (note that
[`adehabitatLT::infolocs`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/adehabitatLT/man/burst.html)
already returns `NULL` if there is no infolocs);

## Usage

``` r
infolocs(ltraj, which, by = c("burst", "id", "none"), simplify = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

- ltraj:

  An object of class `ltraj`.

- which:

  An optional character vector containing the names of the variables in
  the `infolocs` attribute to be returned.

- by:

  Character. Either `"burst"`, `"id"`, or `"none"` to return only one
  element for all bursts/id together.

- simplify:

  Logical. If a single variable is requested, should the function return
  1-column data frames (`FALSE`, default) or vector (`TRUE`).

## See also

See [`infolocs`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/adehabitatLT/man/burst.html) for
further details on the function and all available arguments.

## Author

Modified by Mathieu Basille <mathieu@basille.org>

## Examples

``` r
## Load puechcirc data, and add some random infolocs:
data(puechcirc)
infolocs(puechcirc)
#> NULL
info <- list(data.frame(A = rnorm(80), B = runif(80), C = rpois(80,
    1)), data.frame(A = rnorm(69, 10), B = runif(69, 10, 11),
    C = rpois(69, 10)), data.frame(A = rnorm(66, -10), B = runif(66,
    -10, -9), C = rpois(66, 100)))
## Watch the row names (for a reason, 'puechcirc[[2]]' starts with line 2):
info <- mapply(function(x, y) {
    row.names(x) <- row.names(y)
    return(x)
}, info, puechcirc, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
infolocs(puechcirc) <- info
puechcirc
#> 
#> *********** List of class ltraj ***********
#> 
#> Type of the traject: Type II (time recorded)
#> * Time zone: Europe/Paris *
#> Regular traject. Time lag between two locs: 600 seconds
#> 
#> Characteristics of the bursts:
#>     id    burst nb.reloc NAs          date.begin            date.end
#> 1 CH93 CH930824       80  16 1993-08-24 17:00:00 1993-08-25 06:10:00
#> 2 CH93 CH930827       69  17 1993-08-27 19:10:00 1993-08-28 06:30:00
#> 3 JE93 JE930827       66  19 1993-08-27 19:20:00 1993-08-28 06:10:00
#> 
#> 
#>  infolocs provided. The following variables are available:
#> [1] "A" "B" "C"

## Parameters "by" and "simplify"
infolocs(puechcirc, "A", simplify = TRUE)
```
